output:
To: timeline:rosario.bautista
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: none

HAPPY HAPPY NEWS!!! 🎉🎉🎉 My best friend @Lorna Villaruz is officially a UK registered nurse!!! Her NMC PIN came through today and I am so happy I can’t even type properly. Lorna, I am so proud of you, my sister from another mother!!!

Lorna and I trained together at nursing school in Iloilo. Our capping ceremony was 1996, same hairstyle, same dream, same white shoes that we polished every single night in the dorm. Well, I polished mine. Lorna always borrowed my shoe polish and never bought her own, lol! Some things never change.

She has worked in Riyadh and then Dubai for almost 18 years. And all that time I was here in Liverpool saying come, come, come. Twenty years of me telling her to come! When I left for the UK in 2004 she cried at the airport and said “Susunod ako, I will follow you.” And now, 22 years later, she is finally following me!! 😭❤️ Happy tears only, I promise.

She did her OSCE in Nottingham, and of course I sent her a photo of the rain so she knows exactly what she is getting into here. She lands on 14 January, Dubai to Manchester, around 1pm. She starts on 25 January on Ward 7 medical at Mersey Bank Hospital, induction first and then her preceptorship. Ward 7, you are getting the best nurse I know. She is calm, kind, and the patients love her. I have seen her look after people for years and I would trust her with anyone I love.

For her first month she is staying with us, in the spare room. Ben says it’s ok, so it’s official. The boxes are moving, the heater is coming out, and I am under strict instructions to get her a proper coat. Lorna, bring a proper coat. Not the Divisoria one. Liverpool wind is no joke, especially by the waterfront. Primark or TK Maxx, we will sort you out.

And welcome to our Filipino family here, Lorna. The Christmas parties, the potlucks, all of it. Next year you are coming to Simbang Gabi with us at St Teresa’s, nine nights, 6pm. Ben will be there too. You are not alone here. You have us.

So welcome, Lorna. Welcome to Liverpool. Welcome to Ward 7. Welcome home. I have waited a long time for this, and I am so, so happy. See you at Manchester Airport on 14 January!! I’ll be the one waving like mad at arrivals. 🥳✈️❤️
